about: Visa rules for Indian ordinary passport holders, summarised from research on 16 October 2026. Each record links its sources. Rules change often.

visaKeys.OT: Australia, NZ, Japan or Korea visa

records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.rule: Visa required in advance, no visa on arrival. Government fee waived for Indians, small service charge. Tourist visa issuance was reported paused in early 2026 and resuming in October 2026, so confirm it is open. The Ministry of External Affairs has a standing advisory against travel there.

records.name: Malaysia
records.rule: Indian ordinary passport: visa exempt for up to 30 days (tourism, business, social visit, transit) until 31 Dec 2026. Needs passport valid 6 months, return ticket, accommodation proof. Malaysia Digital Arrival Card (MDAC) must be filed online within 3 days before landing, free. Work or study needs a visa. Rule ends 31 Dec 2026 unless renewed: trips spanning January 2027 are UNCERTAIN; a paid eVisa fallback (RM 100 reported by a secondary site) is UNVERIFIED.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Singapore
records.rule: ICA lists India among nationalities that need a valid entry visa; apply online through the ICA Entry Visa e-service via a Singapore based authorised agent; SG Arrival Card (SGAC) free, submit within 3 days before arrival. Stay is set by e-Pass at the checkpoint (commonly 30 days, UNVERIFIED). Visa fee about SGD 30 to 40 plus agent charge, UNVERIFIED. No easing found for a US, UK, Schengen or Canada visa, UNVERIFIED. Transit without visa rules not checked.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Nepal
records.rule: No visa for Indian citizens. Carry a valid passport or Election Commission voter ID card (government photo ID also accepted per old MHA guidance); persons above 65 and below 15 exempt from ID with other photo document; air entry requires ID. No fee. Stay limit and registration after long stays UNVERIFIED. Nepal bans larger INR notes (INR 200 and above per older guidance, UNVERIFIED): carry INR 100 notes or less, or use cards, UPI is partly usable.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Thailand
records.rule: From 15 Sep 2026 Indian ordinary passport holders get 30 days visa free for tourism (previously 60 days). Extension once by up to 30 days at immigration, fee reported 1,900 THB. Visa exempt land border entries capped at 2 per calendar year. Entered before 15 Sep keeps the 60 days stamped. Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) free, submit within 3 days before arrival (beware copycat sites). Visa on arrival no longer applies to India. Onward ticket and funds can be asked.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: South Korea
records.rule: Indian ordinary passport: Korean short stay visa (C-3-9) needed. K-ETA exemption (to 31 Dec 2026) covers only 22 listed jurisdictions (US, Canada, Singapore, UK, Germany etc.), not India; K-ETA is for visa free nationals only. Visa fee INR 3,600 single entry to 90 days, INR 8,100 multiple (effective 1 Aug 2026, via visa application centre, plus service charge about INR 1,100). Processing about 10 working days. Group tourist visa route also exists. e-Arrival Card online before arrival. Easing by US, UK, Schengen or Canada visa for Indians: UNVERIFIED, not found. Visa free Jeju not available to Indians (UNVERIFIED).
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Canada
records.rule: Indian citizens need a Temporary Resident Visa (visitor visa), CAD 100 plus biometrics CAD 85 (valid 10 years; family cap CAD 170); stay up to 6 months; processing reported about 3 to 8 weeks (secondary sites). eTA is not available to Indian passport holders: the conditional eTA list (valid US visa or recent Canadian visa) covers 17 countries and does not include India, so a valid US visa does NOT waive the Canadian visa for Indians. Single and multiple entry visas decided by officer; may need ITRs and funds proof.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: United States of America
records.rule: B1/B2 visitor visa needed (stay set by CBP up to 6 months). MRV application fee about USD 185 (not re-verified today, UNVERIFIED); a new USD 250 Visa Integrity Fee was enacted 4 Jul 2025 and collection start was uncertain through 2026 (UNCERTAIN, check consulate). Visa bond pilot (USD 5,000 to 15,000) covers designated countries; India not listed in snippets found, UNVERIFIED; the programme was formalised by a Federal Register rule dated 3 Aug 2026. Apply in country of residence/nationality; interview waiver rules tightened (UNVERIFIED). US consular exchange rate 98 INR per USD from 25 May 2026. ESTA not available for Indians. Wait times for appointments vary.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: United Arab Emirates
records.rule: Standard route: pre-arranged tourist e-visa (30 days single entry about USD 90 via airline/agent, 60 days about USD 177 per Emirates table, 96 hour transit USD 49, 48 hour USD 10). Conditional visa on arrival for Indian ordinary passport holders: 14 days AED 100, extendable once 14 days for AED 250; or 60 day AED 250 non extendable (Envoy), requires valid US visa or green card, UK residence permit or EU residence permit (official GDRFA/UAE embassy wording is green card or residence permit; some secondary sites say visa), documents valid 6 months, confirmed return ticket. Canada, Singapore, Japan, Korea, Australia, NZ: only residence permit qualifies, not a visitor visa. Schengen visa only: UNCERTAIN, probably does not qualify; confirm with airline. Indians with such eligibility may also apply online pre-arrival (GDRFA service fee AED 253).
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Georgia
records.rule: Indian citizens need a visa unless they hold a valid visa or residence permit from US, UK, Schengen, Canada (and Australia, Japan, Korea, NZ, Israel, Ireland, GCC states per secondary lists): then visa free up to 90 days in any 180 days. Qualifying visa must be valid at entry. Otherwise eVisa at evisa.gov.ge: consular fee from USD 20 plus DuVerify step USD 15 (total about USD 35; secondary source), minimum about 5 working days. From 1 Jan 2026 tourists must hold health/accident insurance (minimum cover reported inconsistently: GEL 30,000 vs USD 30,000, UNCERTAIN).
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Germany
records.rule: Schengen short stay (type C) visa required, up to 90 days in any 180 days. Fee EUR 90 (about INR 9,590) plus visa centre service charge about INR 400 to 3,125 and travel insurance (about EUR 30,000 cover). Apply 6 months to 15 days before travel at the consulate or VFS/other centre; apply at the country of main destination. A US, UK or Canada visa does NOT waive the Schengen visa for Indians. records.name: Mongolia
records.rule: Visa required. Mongolia's official portal evisa.mn issues e-visas (tourist K2 type listed by the Immigration Agency) to nationals of an eligible country list; passport must be valid at least 180 days, the e-visa is non-extendable, and the fee is non-refundable. records.name: Ghana
records.rule: Indian ordinary passport holders are not visa exempt, so a visa is needed before travel. Since 25 May 2026 Ghana runs an official online eVisa portal (Ghana Immigration Service with the Foreign Ministry) for tourism or business, offered as an alternative to applying at a Ghana mission. Approval usually takes 72 to 96 hours, the eVisa is emailed and shown printed or digital at any port of entry. Requirements per NIS: passport valid at least 6 months, passport photo, return ticket, hotel booking or host address, and 180 days bank statement. Business single entry visa is also 30 days. Visas over 90 days or other classes are through an embassy. Landing and exit cards are mandatory for all passengers (from 1 May 2025). Fee: UNVERIFIED. records.name: Papua New Guinea
records.rule: Visa required. PNG's Immigration and Citizenship Authority (ICA) visa on arrival list does not include India (it lists mainly Pacific nations, Singapore, UK, Canada, Japan, Israel, UAE and a few others). Indians apply for a Visitor visa in advance, by paper form or the ICA eVisa portal (evisa.ica.gov.pg) if the portal accepts the nationality (UNVERIFIED). Fee and stay length not verified; ICA fees are charged in USD. A PNG Digital Arrival Card is mandatory, submitted online up to 72 hours before arrival (ICA notice of 6 August 2026). Passport should be valid 6 months (standard, UNVERIFIED). Yellow fever certificate required if arriving from a risk country (UNVERIFIED). Holding a UK or Japan visa does not change the Indian passport's visa requirement; Indian holders of those visas are not named as eased.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: visa fee, stay length, eVisa eligibility for India, and MEA advisory; ICA site blocks plain scripted fetch so only search snippets were read. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Guatemala
records.rule: Conditional. Indian passport holders normally need a visa from a Guatemalan mission (Guatemala has no embassy in India; apply at a mission abroad, in person, about US$50 single entry or US$150 multiple entry per the Guatemalan consulate in the US, roughly Rs 4,200 or Rs 12,600). Entry without a visa for up to 90 days (extendable by 90 per Wikipedia) is reported for holders of a valid US, Canadian, Mexican or Schengen visa or US green card. Arrival form at the airport asks for a local address; onward ticket is often checked by airlines. Passport validity of 6 months beyond stay advised. Yellow fever certificate: not required for travellers from India (only if arriving from a risk country) but UNVERIFIED on an official page. UK, Australia, NZ, Japan and Korea visas do not ease entry. Guatemala is in the CA-4 zone with El Salvador, Honduras and Nicaragua, so the 90 days are shared.
records.note: The visa-free rule for US/Canada/Schengen visa holders was read on Wikipedia and a travel blog, not on a Guatemalan government page. Yellow fever and MEA advisory UNVERIFIED. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Belize
records.rule: Conditional. Indians need a visa unless they hold a valid multiple-entry US, Canadian or Schengen visa (or US/Canada residence permit), which allows visits up to 30 days without a visa (Wikipedia citing Belize exemption list; Belize immigration fee page also says visa fees do not apply to holders of a US visitor visa). Otherwise apply via Belize's honorary consulate or a mission abroad; the official Belize Immigration fee schedule lists single entry BZD 750 for Indians (about Rs 31,000, valid 6 months) and multiple entry BZD 1,000 (12 months). Indians also pay a repatriation fee of BZD 1,200 (about US$600) on arrival per Wikipedia citing Timatic, UNVERIFIED on an official page. Requirements: passport valid over 6 months, itinerary with return, funds of US$75 a day. Yellow fever certificate only if arriving from a risk country, UNVERIFIED. UK, Australia, NZ, Japan, Korea visas do not ease entry.
records.note: Fees and requirements read on immigration.gov.bz; the repatriation fee and the 30 day substitute-visa rule are from Wikipedia only. Fee page says effective 1 May 2020, may be outdated. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Guyana
records.rule: Visa required for Indian ordinary passports. India is not on Guyana's visa-free list (only Indian diplomatic and service passports are exempt) and Guyana's substitute-visa rule (US, Canada, Schengen visa gives 90 days) covers only Guatemala, Honduras and Mexico, so a US/UK/Schengen visa does not ease entry for Indians. Tourists need an approval letter from the Ministry of Home Affairs (Guyana Immigration), after which a visitor visa on arrival for up to 30 days can be issued at the airport (applications through Guyana's online services portal or a mission; fee UNVERIFIED). Expect to show hotel booking, invitation or sponsor details, funds for 30 days and return ticket. Passport valid at least 6 months. Yellow fever certificate: reportedly required for all arrivals aged 1 year and over, UNVERIFIED on an official page.
records.note: Official Guyana embassy list and consulate visa-on-arrival advisory read; fee, e-visa details and yellow fever rule UNVERIFIED. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Paraguay
records.rule: Visa required in advance for Indian ordinary passport holders (India is exempt only for diplomatic, official or service passports). Apply through the Embassy of Paraguay in New Delhi (its older requirements sheet lists a fee of US$100, multiple entry, original documents, police clearance with apostille, bank statements, invitation or reference letter; sheet dates from Dec 2020). Paraguay lets some applicants file online, but they must finish at an embassy or consulate (Wikipedia). One aggregator (Peninsula Visa) claims an e-visa with up to 90 days, which could not be confirmed. Passport valid at least 6 months. Yellow fever vaccination is recommended for visitors and a certificate may be required if arriving from an endemic country; India is not one, UNVERIFIED. A US, UK or Schengen visa waiver for Indians could not be verified, so none is claimed.
records.note: Official ministry site mre.gov.py blocked the request; embassy PDF is from 2020 and may be outdated. Current fee, e-visa and visa-holder easing UNVERIFIED. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Afghanistan
records.rule: Visa required before travel for Indian passport holders. Issued by Afghan missions (Taliban administration); no e-visa or on-arrival route was verified. Stay length, fee, passport validity, entry points and yellow fever certificate rules are UNVERIFIED (one aggregator says 30 days single entry and 100 USD, treat as unconfirmed). US/UK/Schengen/Canada/Australia/NZ/Japan/Korea visas do not ease entry. India has no formal visa-free arrangement. Flights from India are limited and conditions change often.
records.note: Check the Ministry of External Affairs advisory before any travel; it could not be read. UNVERIFIED: no official Afghan or Indian MEA page confirming Indian tourist visa rules was read; sources are aggregators and disagree on fees. Tourism is strongly discouraged by most governments. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Iran
records.rule: Indian citizens are no longer visa-free: the visa waiver for India was reported cancelled on 22 November 2025. A tourist visa (e-visa authorisation through the Iranian MFA portal, evisa.mfa.ir, then stamp at an airport or consulate) should be arranged before travel. Stay normally up to 30 days, extendable. Third-party agents quote about 90 EUR stamp fee plus agent fees, UNVERIFIED. Passport validity (usually 6 months), yellow fever certificate rules and exact entry points are UNVERIFIED. US/UK/Schengen etc. visas do not ease entry; Iran refuses e-visa to US, UK, Canada nationals only, not relevant to Indians. Indian MEA/Embassy Tehran advises Indians to avoid all non-essential travel and to postpone travel for any purpose (advisories Feb, Jun, Jul 2026).
records.note: Check the Ministry of External Affairs advisory before any travel; it could not be read. UNVERIFIED: official evisa.mfa.ir fetch failed (redirect loop) so the current Indian rule was not read from the official portal. Travel advisory in force; flights may be suspended. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Iraq
records.rule: Iraq runs an official e-visa portal (evisa.iq) giving a 30 day visa, single or multiple entry, delivered by email to print. Whether Indian passport holders are eligible for the tourist e-visa, the fee, passport validity, and yellow fever certificate rules are UNVERIFIED. Entry points and any visa on arrival for Indians are UNVERIFIED. US/UK/Schengen etc. visas are not known to ease entry. The Kurdistan Region has a separate regime, UNVERIFIED.
records.note: Check the Ministry of External Affairs advisory before any travel; it could not be read. UNVERIFIED: portal pages were read via search snippets, instructions page was blank (JavaScript). Indian eligibility not confirmed. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Lebanon
records.rule: Indian citizens are not on the General Security list of nationalities granted a free visa on arrival (list read 16 Oct 2026: includes Iraq, UK, US, Canada, Australia, Japan, S. Korea, Schengen states, but not India). A visa or prior entry authorisation is needed. General Security also has a page titled 'Entry of Indian Nationals' (content not readable) and a separate work visa page for Indians. Lebanese embassy fees abroad are about 88 USD single entry (US) or 68 GBP (UK), India fee, stay length, passport validity (6 months suggested) and yellow fever rules are UNVERIFIED. A Lebanese visa is void if the passport has an Israeli stamp. Holding a US/UK/Schengen etc. visa does not by itself ease entry; one embassy page mentions onward ticket, hotel booking and cash proof for some cases.
records.note: Confirmed only that India is not visa-exempt. UNVERIFIED: exact process, fee and tourist rules for Indians; check with the Lebanese mission in India or VFS. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Syria
records.rule: Conditional: prior entry approval needed. India is listed by a tour operator (CultureRoad, Sept 2026 update) among restricted nationalities that need prior approval for all entries, which can take up to one month and is valid for 3 months. A visa fee is charged at borders and airports since July 2025, paid in cash USD; the fee table read does not list India. Visa agencies (Peninsula Visa) say Indians can get an e-Visa for up to 30 days, which conflicts with the approval route, so treat it as unresolved. Passport validity usually 6 months (aggregator claim). Yellow fever certificate: UNVERIFIED. Entry points reported: Damascus and Aleppo airports and the Lebanon land border. Visas from US/UK/Schengen/Canada/Australia/NZ/Japan/Korea are not reported to waive or ease the rule for Indians. Official Syrian foreign ministry or e-visa portal and MEA advisory page could not be read (MEA returned 403).
records.note: Check the Ministry of External Affairs advisory before any travel; it could not be read. Sources conflict: prior approval needed per one operator, e-visa per an agency. UNVERIFIED: no official Syrian source read; sources conflict on e-visa versus prior approval. Check MEA advisory and Indian embassy in Damascus before any plan. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Yemen
records.rule: Visa required before travel (US State Dept page read says all visitors need a visa; the Yemeni embassy in Washington was reported not issuing tourist visas). Sponsor or invitation usually needed and permission from Tourist Police to travel outside Sanaa (Canada advisory). A medical certificate for infectious disease may be requested. Stay length, fee, yellow fever rules and Indian-specific rules: UNVERIFIED. India's MEA has an advisory telling Indians who need to travel to Yemen to register with the Indian Embassy in Riyadh (search snippet only, page returned 403). The US advisory is Level 4 Do Not Travel (10 Oct 2026). No eased entry for US/UK/Schengen or other visas is known.
records.note: Check the Ministry of External Affairs advisory before any travel; it could not be read. UNVERIFIED: no Yemeni government page or full MEA page read. Not a realistic leisure destination: MEA advises against travel and Indian travel to Yemen is restricted. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Libya
records.rule: Visa required. The Libyan embassy in Washington says a Libyan sponsor (usually a company) must request approval from the passports authority first, then the visa is issued with a passport valid at least 6 months and 2 clear pages; its fees for non-US citizens are 150 USD for 30 days single entry, 200 USD for 90 days multiple, 350 USD for 180 days multiple (about Rs 13,000 to Rs 31,000 at roughly 88 INR per USD; this is the Washington embassy's fee, not an Indian-specific one). Visa agencies claim an e-Visa for Indians up to 60 days, not confirmed officially. Passports with Israeli stamps are refused. Yellow fever rules: UNVERIFIED. MEA advisory (search snippet only, page returned 403): Indians should avoid non-essential travel to Libya. No easing for US/UK/Schengen etc. is known.
records.note: Check the Ministry of External Affairs advisory before any travel; it could not be read. UNVERIFIED: Libyan embassy in India or e-visa portal not read; MEA page blocked (403). Tourist visas mostly arranged through sponsors or tour operators. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: North Korea
records.rule: Visa required, but North Korea is closed to international tourism. A tour operator (Young Pioneer Tours, updated 1 Oct 2026) says the country is closed to all tourists except a limited number of Russians; a brief Rason opening in Feb to Mar 2025 for most nationalities ended on 5 March 2025. Tourist visas, when open, are arranged by an approved tour agency with a tourist card, often collected in Beijing (operator sources). Beijing to Pyongyang train resumed 12 March 2026 and Air China flights were announced weekly from 30 March 2026, but these serve official and business travel. Fee, stay, yellow fever rules and Indian specific rules: UNVERIFIED. Canada's advisory (26 May 2026) says avoid all travel and mentions possible Ebola related entry measures. No official North Korean source or MEA page was read. No easing from US/UK/Schengen visas.
records.note: Check the Ministry of External Affairs advisory before any travel; it could not be read. Effectively closed to tourists at the time of research. UNVERIFIED: no official source read. Effectively not available to Indian tourists now. India has an embassy in Pyongyang, MEA position not checked. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Benin
records.rule: E-visa required before travel (Benin's official portal evisa.bj; applications are now electronic only). Official fees when applying yourself: 30 days single entry 50 EUR (about INR 5,000), 30 days multiple 75 EUR, 90 days multiple 100 EUR; 10 EUR more via an embassy. Print the e-visa and carry it. Passport validity and entry points for Indians not read on the official pages: UNVERIFIED. Yellow fever: the Ministry of Health says no vaccination card checks (including yellow fever) are done at airports, ports or land borders, but Benin can change this at any time and the vaccine is recommended; carry the certificate anyway since India may ask on return. No page read says a US/UK/Schengen/Canada/Australia/NZ/Japan/Korea visa eases entry.
records.note: Official portal read but the visa-exempt list (which would confirm India is not exempt) was not opened, so probable. Fee article dated Dec 2020. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Burkina Faso
records.rule: Visa needed, applied for online on Burkina Faso's official e-visa site (visaburkina.bf), which says the e-visa allows entry and stay up to 90 days. Fees listed on the official short-stay page: tourist visa 33,000 CFA single entry (about INR 5,000) or 55,000 CFA multiple, hotel reservation required; business 77,000 / 93,500 CFA; express 104,500 CFA. Whether Indians have any exemption or a different fee and the exact entry points: UNVERIFIED. Yellow fever certificate is expected on entry (US embassy page; not confirmed from an official Burkina page). Passport validity 6 months is standard but UNVERIFIED on the official page. No evidence that a US/UK/Schengen/Canada/Australia/NZ/Japan/Korea visa eases entry.
records.note: Check the Ministry of External Affairs advisory before any travel; it could not be read. Official portal read (home page); fee table came from the official page's search snippet only and the applicant portal is JavaScript-only. MEA advisory not located (UNVERIFIED). Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Mali
records.rule: Visa required in advance. The Embassy of Mali in New Delhi says all applications go through Mali's official digital portal (diplomatiemdc.gouv.ml) since 11 March 2025, with no paper applications. Documents: passport valid at least 6 months, photo, legalized invitation letter or hotel reservation, return flight booking, yellow fever vaccination card. Processing 5 to 10 business days. Fee and stay length not stated on the page: UNVERIFIED. No evidence that a US/UK/Schengen/Canada/Australia/NZ/Japan/Korea visa eases entry.
records.note: Check the Ministry of External Affairs advisory before any travel; it could not be read. Embassy page read; fee, stay length and any MEA advisory UNVERIFIED. Security is poor, see cautions. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Niger
records.rule: Visa required in advance, applied at the Embassy of Niger in New Delhi in person (reported by an aggregator, not an official page I could open): tourist single-entry about INR 5,000, processing 2 to 3 working days, cash or demand draft, yellow fever certificate checked. These figures and any e-visa are UNVERIFIED. Stay length UNVERIFIED. Niger's official immigration and embassy pages were not found or read. A US/UK/Schengen/Canada/Australia/NZ/Japan/Korea visa is not known to ease entry.
records.note: Check the Ministry of External Affairs advisory before any travel; it could not be read. UNVERIFIED: only an aggregator was read; no official Niger source. A search snippet pointed to an older MEA advisory asking non-essential Indians to leave Niger (2023 era, original not read). Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Togo
records.rule: E-visa required for Indians per secondary sources (tourist e-visa about 15 days, government fee reported as USD 50, roughly INR 4,400, processing 3 to 7 business days). One aggregator also mentions a short visa on arrival of up to 7 days, which conflicts with others, so treat arrival as unreliable and get the e-visa before flying. Passport valid 6 months, return ticket, accommodation proof. Yellow fever certificate required. Entry mainly Lome airport (LFW) and land borders. No evidence that US, UK, Schengen, Canada, Australia, NZ, Japan or Korea visas ease it.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: official portal evisa.republicoftogo.com returned no readable content; fee, stay and any arrival option come from aggregators only. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Gambia
records.rule: Official Gambia Immigration Department page lists India among Asian countries that need BOTH a visa and entry clearance (security clearance), so apply before travel through a Gambian mission or the official channel. Short visit visa covers up to 90 days for bona fide tourists or business visitors who are residents of the applying country, with return or onward ticket and funds. Fee not shown on page read: UNVERIFIED. Gambia has no embassy in India as far as verified, so check the nearest mission. Yellow fever vaccination card required per gambia.gov.gm. No evidence that US, UK, Schengen or other visas ease it.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: visa fee, application route for Indians, processing time; gid.gov.gm needs certificate bypass to load. Some sources mention a Gambia e-visa or travel authorisation, not confirmed. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Guinea
records.rule: Official Guinea eVisa portal (paf.gov.gn) says foreign nationals need a visa except visa-waiver countries; apply online, receive an Entry Visa Letter, then collect the visa at the on-arrival counter with photo and fingerprints. Fees shown on the portal include USD 100 for a stay not exceeding 90 days and USD 50 for short 3-day visas (roughly INR 8,800 and INR 4,400); the exact tourist line for Indians was not clearly mapped. Yellow fever certificate required. Bring the Entry Visa Letter, return ticket and funds proof. Entry mainly Conakry airport (CKY). No evidence that US, UK, Schengen or other visas ease it.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: portal text was read as flattened HTML so the fee-to-visa-type mapping and India-specific rule are not certain; passport validity not confirmed. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Guinea-Bissau
records.rule: MEA's Visa Facility for Indian Nationals page (search snippet) says Guinea-Bissau has visa on arrival for Indians, valid 90 days, fee USD 100 (about INR 8,800), and advises getting an authorisation from the Ministry of Interior on request of a host or employer. Yellow fever certificate is generally expected; UNVERIFIED. Entry mainly Bissau airport (OXB). No evidence that US, UK, Schengen or other visas ease it.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: mea.gov.in blocked direct fetch (403), so rule is from the search snippet; no Guinea-Bissau government page read; passport validity and yellow fever rule unconfirmed. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Sierra Leone
records.rule: E-visa required for Indian passport holders (Indians are not on the visa-exempt or free-arrival lists), applied via the official evisa.sl portal; visa on arrival also reported at Freetown airport and two land borders for about USD 80 (about INR 7,000) but pre-applying online is the safe route. Exact stay length and Indian-specific fee not shown on the pages I could read (portal is JavaScript only). Passport validity of 6 months is typical, UNVERIFIED. Yellow fever certificate is required on entry per standard Sierra Leone rules, UNVERIFIED on an official page. No waiver or easing from US/UK/Schengen/Canada/Australia/NZ/Japan/Korea visas found.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: evisa.sl is a JavaScript page with no readable rules; fee and stay from Wikipedia lead only; yellow fever and MEA advisory not checked on official pages. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Liberia
records.rule: Visa on arrival by air only at Roberts International Airport (Monrovia), pre-approved online at visaonarrival.lis.gov.lr. Fee USD 102.5 (about INR 9,000), non-refundable, card payment. Apply at least 7 days before flying; approval valid 3 months for entry; single visit, officer sets validity of 30 or 90 days. Passport valid 6 months, photo, passport scan needed; biometrics collected on arrival. The portal says that if a Liberian embassy exists in your country you must apply at the embassy instead; I did not confirm whether an embassy covers India, so check. Yellow fever certificate required per the Liberian embassy in the US page. No easing from US/UK/Schengen etc. found.
records.note: Official portal read; Indian nationals' eligibility and embassy-in-India rule not explicitly confirmed. MEA advisory not checked. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Mauritania
records.rule: E-visa via the official government portal anrpts.gov.mr (Ministry of the Interior). Packages of 30, 90 or 360 days, issued electronically for entry at all international ports of entry. Fee amounts were not visible on the page I read and Indian eligibility is not listed there. Press reports say e-visa became mandatory before boarding from 5 January 2025 and visa on arrival is reported by an aggregator but UNVERIFIED. Passport valid 6 months and yellow fever certificate reported by an aggregator only. No easing from US/UK/Schengen etc. found.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: fees, whether Indians qualify for arrival visa, yellow fever rule. Portal read only partly. Mauritania has MEA/other advisories for the east and Mali border zones, not checked. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Cameroon
records.rule: Visa required; Cameroon runs an official e-visa portal at evisacam.cm. Fees from aggregators range USD 187 to 369 consular fee for e-visa depending on validity and speed (about INR 16,500 to 32,500), plus service fees on agent sites; official fee list not readable (JavaScript portal). Passport validity, stay and Indian-specific terms UNVERIFIED. Yellow fever certificate is required on entry, UNVERIFIED on an official page. No easing from US/UK/Schengen etc. found.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: official portal returned only a title; fees come from aggregators. MEA advisory not checked; Anglophone regions and Far North are flagged by many governments. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Central African Republic
records.rule: Visa required in advance from a CAR mission or a French mission; no on-arrival or e-visa found for Indians. Processing 1 to 4 weeks, fee set by the mission (UNVERIFIED amount). Passport valid at least 3 months on arrival (aggregator). Yellow fever certificate: DR Congo and CAR require it (India's embassy in Kinshasa asks for it 10 days before travel, plus polio); Chad and Congo also commonly require it, UNVERIFIED from official sources. No visa waiver or easing from US/UK/Schengen/Canada/Australia/NZ/Japan/Korea visas found. Entry mainly by air at Bangui. Indian embassy in Kinshasa covers CAR; MEA/embassy advise caution, treat as high risk, avoid road travel and areas outside Bangui.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: no official CAR immigration page found; fee and Indian-specific rule from aggregator only. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Chad
records.rule: Visa required, issued online on the official portal evisa.td; apply at least 7 days before entry and not more than 90 days before. Fee is not refundable and the issued e-visa cannot be edited. Fee, stay length and Indian-specific eligibility not shown on pages read (aggregators say up to 90 days; UNVERIFIED). Passport usually 6 months validity (aggregator). Police registration within 72 hours (Wikipedia, UNVERIFIED). Yellow fever certificate: DR Congo and CAR require it (India's embassy in Kinshasa asks for it 10 days before travel, plus polio); Chad and Congo also commonly require it, UNVERIFIED from official sources. No easing from US/UK/Schengen/Canada/Australia/NZ/Japan/Korea visas found. Advisory: treat eastern border and Lake Chad areas as restricted; check MEA and Indian mission advice.
records.note: Official portal confirms online visa; fee, stay length and vaccination rules UNVERIFIED. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Congo
records.rule: Visa required for Indians. The Republic of the Congo is launching an e-visa and ETA platform; a 30 day single entry tourist visa was listed at 17,000 XAF (about 2,500 INR), provisional, and tourist stay up to 90 days (news report). Whether Indians are eligible and the platform is live is UNVERIFIED. Otherwise apply at a Congolese embassy. Passport 6 months validity (republic-congo.com). Yellow fever certificate: DR Congo and CAR require it (India's embassy in Kinshasa asks for it 10 days before travel, plus polio); Chad and Congo also commonly require it, UNVERIFIED from official sources. No easing from US/UK/Schengen/Canada/Australia/NZ/Japan/Korea visas found. Main entry Maya-Maya airport Brazzaville, Pointe-Noire.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: official e-visa portal could not be read; fee provisional. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
records.rule: Visa required in advance from the DRC embassy in New Delhi. Embassy listed fees: 1 month single entry 6,100 INR, 3 months multiple 13,250 INR, 6 months multiple 21,200 INR. Needs international yellow fever certificate, and proof of funds of at least 5,000 USD (embassy page). DRC also runs an e-visa portal but it could not be read, so Indian eligibility is UNVERIFIED. Passport validity UNVERIFIED. No easing from US/UK/Schengen/Canada/Australia/NZ/Japan/Korea visas found. Advisory: India's embassy in Kinshasa warns on security; eastern provinces (North and South Kivu, Ituri) are conflict zones and should be avoided.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: embassy page read via search excerpt; e-visa portal not readable (evisa.gouv.cd failed). Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Gabon
records.rule: E-visa required for Indian ordinary passport holders (Gabon runs an official e-visa portal, evisa.dgdi.ga, for arrival at Libreville Leon Mba airport; the portal says Gabon has established an e-visa to facilitate entry). Per press reports (VisasNews) the fee was paid in cash on arrival, with online payment planned from Dec 2025; current fee, stay length and any passport validity rule are UNVERIFIED (official portal would not load with a valid certificate from this server and the portal is JavaScript driven). A temporary 2025 Tourist Caravan promotion (1 Jul to 30 Sep 2025) has ended. Yellow fever certificate: Gabon is understood to require it for travellers aged 1 year and over, UNVERIFIED. No evidence that a US/UK/Schengen/Canada/Australia/NZ/Japan/Korea visa waives or eases it.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: fee, stay length, yellow fever rule; official portal evisa.dgdi.ga could not be read (TLS error and JavaScript). Embassy page read is only a 2025 promo notice. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Equatorial Guinea
records.rule: Visa required before arrival. Equatorial Guinea launched an e-visa from 1 July 2023 (Fragomen and Wikipedia report: all nationalities can apply, government fee USD 75, about Rs 6,600, approval in 24 to 72 hours, e-visa holders arrive via Malabo airport). A sticker visa via an embassy is also possible; the US embassy page lists a USD 200 standard fee and requires an invitation letter and proof of funds (not an Indian-specific page). Passport validity 6 months and a blank page per that embassy page. Yellow fever certificate understood to be required, UNVERIFIED. No evidence that other-country visas ease entry. Current fee and rules for Indians UNVERIFIED.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: no official Equatorial Guinea government e-visa page read; fee and Indian-specific rule from secondary sources and a foreign embassy page. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Sao Tome and Principe
records.rule: Indian passport holders need a visa (the visa-free 15 day list covers UK, US, Canada, EU, CPLP nationals; Indians are not on it per secondary sources). A visa must be obtained before arrival via the e-visa portal (evisa.st, processing about 7 days) or an embassy, plus a EUR 20 cash fee at São Tomé airport for those needing a visa (Principe Collection FAQ). Standard visa: 30 day stay, single entry, passport valid 12 months (saotomeislands.com, a private eVisa site). Per the Principe Collection FAQ a valid US or Schengen visa in the passport (and per VisaHQ a Schengen visa or permit held in the US) gives the 15 day visa waiver program; wording is inconsistent, so treat as probable only and confirm before flying. Yellow fever certificate: UNVERIFIED.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: no government immigration page read; US and Schengen easing comes from a hotel FAQ; fee and yellow fever rule unconfirmed. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Comoros
records.rule: Visa on arrival for 45 days. India's MEA visa facility list (text seen in search result; the page itself returned 403 to a direct fetch) says Comoros: visa on arrival for 45 days, fee EUR 30, proof of accommodation and return air ticket required. Private sources agree (EUR 30 cash at Hahaya airport, Moroni; passport valid 6 months). Yellow fever certificate is needed only if arriving from a risk country, UNVERIFIED for India direct. Outer island travel may need a local permit or ferry paperwork, UNVERIFIED. No easing from other visas needed.

records.rule: Visa required before travel for Indian ordinary passport holders (Wikipedia/Timatic-based listing says visa required; Australia's Smartraveller confirms a visa is needed). records.name: Burundi
records.rule: Visa on arrival for Indian passport holders, up to 30 days, reported fee about 90 USD single entry (Burundian embassy in Washington lists 90 USD for a 30 day visa and requires a pre-boarding online form for arrival visas). Complete the online arrival form before boarding. Passport valid 6 months with a blank page, proof of funds, return ticket. Yellow fever vaccination certificate is requested (embassy lists it among visa documents; treat as required). Entry via Bujumbura airport and land borders. Some sources say a pre-authorised e-visa is available. No known waiver from US, UK, Schengen, Canada, Australia, NZ, Japan or Korea visas since visa on arrival is already open to Indians.

records.name: Ukraine
records.rule: Indians need a visa. Ukraine's MFA entry regime table lists India as 'visa, including e-Visa', and the Ukrainian embassy in India says e-Visa is open to Indian citizens. E-Visa is single or double entry, 30 days, fee 20 USD single and 30 USD double (doubled for urgent), apply at evisa.mfa.gov.ua. Categories include tourism, private, business. Embassy-issued stickers are also possible. Passport validity and vaccination certificate: UNVERIFIED (no yellow fever requirement known). Martial law is in force and Ukrainian airspace is closed to civil flights, so entry is only overland via Poland, Romania, Moldova, Hungary or Slovakia. No waiver from US, UK, Schengen, Canada, Australia, NZ, Japan or Korea visas is known for Indians. Wikipedia says e-Visa for Indians was reintroduced from 17 Feb 2025.
records.note: Check the Ministry of External Affairs advisory before any travel; it could not be read. Official mfa.gov.ua pages returned 403 on direct fetch; content read only from search excerpts, so UNVERIFIED in full. Active war: MEA has advised Indians against travel to Ukraine (not re-read). Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

Yellow fever: El Salvador's tourism site says arrivals from Panama, South America or Africa need a certificate taken 15 days earlier; India is not on that list, so a direct trip from India needs none, but a connection through those regions does.
